title: Countless Thoughts of Love
story:
A child once asked his grandmother how much she loved him.

The grandmother smiled and said,

“Let’s count the grains of sand on the beach.”

The child laughed.

“That’s impossible!” he said.

The grandmother gently replied,

“Exactly. That’s how much you are loved.”

In life, people often feel unnoticed or forgotten.

They think no one is thinking about them.

But God’s thoughts are different.

They are more than the grains of sand.

He is always mindful of each person.

Even when we sleep.

Even when we are unaware.

His care never stops.

And His love never runs out.
life_lesson: God’s thoughts toward you are countless and full of love.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for thinking about me always.

Help me to understand how deeply I am loved by You.

When I feel forgotten, remind me that You are near.

Fill my heart with peace and security in Your love.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you ever feel unnoticed or forgotten?

How does it change you to know God is always thinking about you?

How can you rest in His love today?
verse:
How precious to me are Your thoughts, God!
How vast is the sum of them!
Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand.
